operation.body:
### Goal

Close FR-007 meaningful test coverage: audit the suite against `.ai/docs/project-requirements.md` FR-007 and acceptance details, then add focused tests only where observable behaviour is not yet covered at an appropriate boundary.

### Acceptance criteria

- Map FR-007 scope (submission, validation, categorization, filtering, persistence) to existing tests and record any gaps addressed in the pull request description.
- Add or adjust tests so blank **description** on create is covered at the request boundary (alongside existing blank-title coverage).
- Inbox ordering with **tied timestamps** is verified at an integration/controller boundary, not only in the model unit test.
- Category filtering is exercised for each allowed category (`bug`, `feature request`, `other`) plus `all` and empty-result messaging (extend only if a category is missing today).
- Persistence remains covered by the existing restart integration test; do not duplicate FR-005 process-restart machinery unless a gap is proven.
- Pull request contains exact `Closes #<this-issue-number>` and stays within FR-007 scope (no FR-008 documentation sweep, no new product features).
- `bin/rails test` passes; CI green on the pull request.

### Constraints

- Ruby on Rails, SQLite, server-rendered HTML; MIT license; no authentication.
- Build on current `main` at `a8cab50` (goals through FR-006 merged).
- Do not edit `docs/security-review.md` or implement goal #3 work.
- Keep CI economical; prefer extending `test/controllers/feedbacks_controller_test.rb` and existing integration tests over new layers.

### Out of scope

- FR-008 README/roadmap/demo-guide/sample-data consistency pass, demo recording, and broad documentation rewrites.
- Refactors unrelated to test coverage, new dependencies, or production hosting.

### Relevant context

Controller, model, and restart persistence tests already exist from FR-001–FR-006 goals. FR-007 is the explicit test-gap closure milestone before the FR-008 documentation goal. Parent project #2 targets FR-001–FR-008 overall.
